name: v0.9.0
body:
## New

- **Ghostwriter connection settings in the web UI**: Settings -> Sync now lets you set the API endpoint URL and toggle SSL verification, saved straight to your config file. No more hand-editing TOML to point GhostPiper at your server.
- **Internal CA certificates now work out of the box**: HTTPS connections to Ghostwriter use your operating system trust store (Windows certificate store, macOS Keychain, Linux system trust). If your machine trusts your Ghostwriter server certificate, so does GhostPiper. No SSL_CERT_FILE workarounds needed.
- `GW_API_ENDPOINT` is the canonical environment variable for the API endpoint. `GW_API_URL` still works but is deprecated.

## Fixed

- Editing the Ghostwriter endpoint in the config file previously had no effect because two separate config systems never talked to each other. Endpoint configuration is now a single source of truth across the CLI, web UI, and diagnostic scripts.
- The hardcoded default endpoint is gone. Fresh installs get a clear "configure via Settings -> Sync" message instead of silently targeting a baked-in host.
- Endpoint URLs ending in `/v1/graphql` are no longer mangled by an auto-appended `/graphql`.
- The Mapping page filter (handed off from the Findings page) no longer disappears after creating a mapping or refreshing the page. It stays applied until you click **Show all** in the filter banner.
- The in-app update check now compares versions correctly after pulling a release.

## Upgrade notes

This release adds two dependencies (`truststore`, `tomli-w`). After pulling, run:

```
pip install -r requirements.lock
pip install -e . --no-deps
```
